projections.label: PROJECTION - not actual results
assumptions: Seed SAFE of 5,000,000 closes in February 2027 (target close 26 Feb 2027).
Customer F's 15 contracted seats are billed from January 2027; other seats grow by 4 a month from February 2027.
Revenue is subscription revenue only, collected in the month billed. Onboarding fees are left out, including the 30,000 already collected from Customer F in October 2026.
Headcount rises from 11 to 21 by August 2027 under the hiring plan; the two contract engineers continue.
Costs: 14,500 per employee a month, 22,000 for contractors, hosting at 1,500 plus 150 per seat, and 14,000 of other operating costs.

knownDiscrepancies.accountsStatement: The payroll shows 10 employees at 30 Sep 2026 (11 at 31 Oct 2026); two contract forward-deployed engineers are paid through cost of revenue.
knownDiscrepancies.reason: The founder counted the two contract forward-deployed engineers in the team of 12 on the profile. The accounts and the team plan count employees only, so the payroll headcount at 30 Sep 2026 is 10.

evidence.text: 10 employees and 2 contract forward-deployed engineers at 30 Sep 2026

knownDiscrepancies.profileStatement: Contracted ARR 1,080,000 at 31 Oct 2026 (KPI pack and deck).
knownDiscrepancies.accountsStatement: Subscription revenue recognised in October 2026 is 72,000, 864,000 annualised.
knownDiscrepancies.reason: Customer F signed on 7 Oct 2026 for 15 seats, but its subscription starts after its deployment team moves onto the platform, so its 216,000 a year counts in contracted ARR from October 2026 and in billed revenue only from January 2027. Its 30,000 onboarding fee was invoiced and collected in October and sits in deferred revenue.
